sections_specifications.title: Hero Section
elements: Concise first-person introduction for Ansik Aryan Samal
Bold label: 'Built by voice'
Chapter navigation links (Quick jump to 8 sections)
Audio Play button with real placeholder audio playback, animated SVG waveform canvas, and visible transcript badge ('Sample — no recording yet')
Kinetic headline text reveal

sections_specifications.title: The Autopsy
elements: 6 expandable project decision cards (Context, Decision, Reason, Outcome/Evidence with 'Evidence needed' badges, Lesson)
Dedicated Mistakes & Failures Panel (Honesty log)
3 Growth Experiment Cards marked with 'Proposal' badge

sections_specifications.title: Voice-First Bharat
elements: Sample job-profile voice input demo with preset Indian vernacular sample voice buttons (Hindi, Odia, English)
Editable transcript text box
Structured result card output (Extracted Skills, Salary expectation, Preferred Location, Experience Level)
Optional microphone trigger button (requests browser permission only when clicked with clear visual state)

sections_specifications.title: The Secret Layer
elements: Image-based interactive easter egg hunt with 3 visual clue cards hiding letters
Target hidden word: 'OUT'
Answer input field with instant check & reveal mechanism
Retry feedback animations on incorrect guess
Always-visible 'Reveal Spoiler' button for full accessibility

sections_specifications.title: Voice Receipts
elements: Interactive timeline cards mapping Voice Input Audio -> Raw Transcript -> Resulting Product Change
All cards explicitly tagged with 'Placeholder — Demonstration Only' badge

sections_specifications.title: Projects & Skills
elements: Browsable placeholder project cards (Overview, Work Completed, Tech Tools, Interactive Modal/Links)
Skill matrix grouped by Voice AI Architecture, Product Strategy, UI/UX Engineering, and Research

sections_specifications.title: About Me
elements: Brief professional summary for Ansik Aryan Samal (owner name used deliberately & sparingly)
Core design philosophy cards and product principles

sections_specifications.title: Contact Me
elements: Contact form placeholders for Name, Email, Location, Message
Social profile links (GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Email)
Strict 'No Data Collected' privacy guarantee badge

motion_and_accessibility.global_animation_toggle: Sticky header toggle button for Motion ON/OFF site-wide
motion_and_accessibility.honesty_rules: No invented metric claims without 'Evidence needed' disclaimer tag
motion_and_accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-indigo-500 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-slate-900)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 8 sections are rendered in exact sequential order on a single page
Implement the motion toggle state globally via React context or root state, passing motion-safe properties to framer-motion components
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as mapped above
Maintain high APCA text contrast ratio using #0A0D14 background with #F8FAFC text and indigo/emerald accents
Never hide essential content when animation is toggled OFF — only disable CSS/Framer motion transitions
